name: WildBench
description: A benchmark of 1,024 challenging real-world user queries curated from WildChat logs, evaluated using task-specific checklists via WB-Reward and WB-Score metrics. Achieves 0.98 Pearson correlation with Chatbot Arena Elo ratings on hard tasks, making it one of the highest-fidelity automated proxies for human preference evaluation.
evaluation_method: WB-Score (LLM-as-judge with task-specific checklists); WB-Reward (pairwise win rate)
reputation: Published at ICLR 2025; from Allen Institute for AI; 0.98 Pearson correlation with Chatbot Arena; used alongside AlpacaEval and Arena-Hard as primary automatic evaluation benchmark
notes: Accepted at ICLR 2025. Queries sourced from real WildChat user interactions ensure ecological validity. Task-specific checklists (rather than generic rubrics) enable fine-grained evaluation. 0.98 Pearson correlation with Chatbot Arena Elo on hard tasks makes it one of the best automated human preference proxies. From Allen Institute for AI.
